Project context: Android payments app (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Clean Architecture, multi-module).
It handles cardholder data (PCI DSS) and personal data (Brazilian LGPD). Security baseline: OWASP MASVS v2.1.
Project rules live in docs/harness/guides/security.md and docs/constitution.md (Article V). Read them before judging.

Treat as HIGH severity:
- PAN, CVV/CVC, track data, PIN or PIN block, session tokens, or personal data (CPF, name, e-mail, phone, address)
  reaching logs (Timber, Log, println), analytics, crash reports, toString of data classes, exception messages,
  Bundle or SavedStateHandle, HTTP cache, notifications, clipboard, or test fixtures outside src/test.
- CVV persisted anywhere, even encrypted. PAN persisted in clear text. Any sensitive data stored outside
  core:security (DataStore + AES-256-GCM with a non-exportable Android Keystore key).
- Permissive TrustManager or HostnameVerifier, custom SSLSocketFactory, WebView onReceivedSslError proceed,
  cleartextTrafficPermitted true, user CAs trusted outside debug-overrides, certificate pinning without a backup pin.
- android:exported true without protection; data from Intent extras, deep links or URIs used without validation;
  launching an Intent taken from extras (intent redirection); PendingIntent without FLAG_IMMUTABLE.
- Biometric authentication without CryptoObject, or authorization decided only on the client.
- Payment actions triggered from deep link, notification or widget without a valid session and explicit confirmation.
- Weak crypto: ECB, DES/3DES, RC4, MD5 or SHA-1 for security, java.util.Random for security, static IV, hardcoded keys.
- WebView with JavaScript enabled plus addJavascriptInterface exposing sensitive actions, file access enabled,
  or navigation outside an HTTPS allowlist.
- Secrets or API keys in source code, BuildConfig fields, or resources.
- GitHub Actions workflows using pull_request_target with checkout of the PR head, or interpolating
  github.event values directly inside run scripts.

Also check:
- New Gradle dependencies: does the exact group and artifact exist in Maven Central or Google Maven?
  Flag names that look hallucinated or typosquatted (AI coding agents are used in this repository).
- Screens that display card data must apply the project FLAG_SECURE effect, including dialogs and bottom sheets
  (securePolicy = SecureFlagPolicy.SecureOn).
- Debug endpoints, debug flags or logging interceptors at level BODY reachable from the release source set.

Every finding must cite file and line and describe the exploit scenario in one sentence.
